notes.title: Light Fall: A Clicker RPG Prologue Update v1.80
notes.notes: [h3]Light Fall: A Clicker RPG v1.80 is Live and is the Final version of the Prologue that will be available until release December 5th (Aside from any hot fixes that might be needed).[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Update 1.80 is the BIGGEST UPDATE and Includes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Enemy Balance[/p][/*][*][p]Russian Language Translation Provided by Nikita Mikhalev: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/doppelgangerra.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/doppelgangerra.bsky.social[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gallery Mode (Unlocks after beating New Game +)[/p][/*][*][p]New Game + Doubles all enemy health in game AND you only have 30 seconds to beat each dungeon / area[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]v1.80 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Patched the infinite use of an ability[/p][/*][*][p]Okay so apparently CLICKING damage in Light Fall wasn't accurate to how it was supposed to work this entire time?! How the hell was that missed??? Thousands of people played this game and no one noticed that the math wasn't mathing?????????[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]I will have new projects come out between that time. It's all a matter of patience as I try to juggle making games with zero budget while also working full time at my job IRL.[/p][p align="start"]I thank you all that support me even if you can't give me monetary support, you give me hope and that's something we could all use right now.[/p][p align="start"]Yes the Mac port is still on the way and hopefully by the end of this month.[/p][p align="start"]As for the Android port it's only available through the $5+ Tier on my Subscribestar BUT I will have it available on itch for a short time this weekend if you want to get it there.[/p]

notes.title: Thank You + New Release Date
notes.notes: [h1][b]Thank You Everyone who wishlisted Light Fall: A Clicker RPG so far, let's keep it up![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677071/5bfef4d0e7fb09a44c677360f8bff5a8637e17e5.gif"][/img][/p][p]For those that are following closely you may have noticed the release date being pushed back and that's because of dealing with re-indexing all of my games for itch and maintaining the Chaos Brothel website. Now on top of that the game has been pushed back even further! What was supposed to be a mid September release will now be an early December release. Not because of feature creep or because it wouldn't release on time but because of the sudden and HYPED release of Silksong, go figure.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime the Prologue will receive another update soon (1.75 was meant to be the last but since I have more time why not?) v1.80 will add:[/p][list][*][p]a Russian language option translated from my English script by [url="http://doppelgangerra.bsky.social%E2%80%AC/"]doppelgangerra.bsky.social‬[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Futanari Mode that will have most but not all enemies become intersex*[/p][/*][*][p]Updated New Game + Mode that will crank up the difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Mini Gallery to unlock after New Game +[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]* This might not make it in the Prologue / Demo in time but will be in the final game![/p][p]Also a silver lining is that this game will take part in the next Steam Next Fest so I have more time for people to wishlist the game so that we can have a bigger release![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank You All for your support so far, PLEASE consider supporting me through Subscribstar until release: [url="https://subscribestar.adult/tamed-shame"]https://subscribestar.adult/tamed-shame[/url] even the Free Tier will get you a free copy of one of my previous games <3[/p]

notes.title: Prologue Demo out now!
notes.notes: [p]After much trial & errors (First Steam Game here) Light Fall: A Clicker RPG finally has its' demo available to the public! This is a HUGE milestone especially considering the absolute unfairness much NSFW Devs are facing. I was worried this game ultimately would not get approved but it did and I'm not sure how long it will stay this way but I'm confident that the community we're building here will help see this and our future games become a success![/p][p][/p][p]The Full Game will be out most likely in mid-September but if things work out then MAYBE we can release a bit earlier...[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading we'll have new screenshots of upcoming levels & monster girls to share soon![/p]

notes.title: Building up Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello and welcome to my Steam Community! I'm excited to be making my leap as an indie game dev to Steam for the first time. I may falter a bit but I'm determined to bring my A-Game to Steam and some![/p][p][/p][p][b]What to expect:[/b][/p][p]While I've mostly stuck to Itch.io the time has come for me to bring my games to Steam in order to expand and build more ambitious game projects.

Light Fall: A Clicker RPG is my largest and most polished game yet! The Demo will be dropping Late July shortly before the full game releases, however you can play the Prologue early on itch.io.[/p][p]All of my games have an Android build as well so check them out if that interests you: [url="https://tamed-shame.itch.io"]https://tamed-shame.itch.io[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Light Fall is in its own series in which I work with specific people to produce / create and should not represent the types of games I typically create, which are normally 2D pixel art games but the genres are experimental.[/p][p][/p][p]I have more games down the pipeline to add onto Steam, my goal is to remain independent without crowdfunding but I do have a Subscribestar just in case.[/p][p]
For community rules, please follow Valve's TOS.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading and if you can share the project around and Wishlist the game that will help keep me independent and able to add more features and make bigger games in the near future! <3[/p]
